title: Letter and Autopsy
author: J. M. Coldharbour
blurb: Cyrus Vasquez, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
